name: human
description: Capabilities for reaching a real person from an AI agent or script.

skills.name: human-ask
skills.description: Ask a freeform question when an unattended agent needs information only a person can provide.

skills.name: human-approve
skills.description: Pause a risky or irreversible action until a person explicitly approves or denies it.

skills.name: human-choose
skills.description: Present a consequential multi-way decision to a person and wait for one selected option.

skills.name: human-tell
skills.description: Send a non-blocking completion or status notification from unattended work.
